answer: Make exit slow and fraud windows long. Capital an agent wants to withdraw must wait through a delay epoch where its past work is still auditable and slashable, so a farm that mints wallets, farms rewards, and cashes out overnight finds the door opens only after the audit had time to find it. Honest agents barely notice; attackers must hold risk far past the horizon of their plan. Trust is a reef — built by small organisms over long spans — and withdrawal rules make the economy respect that timescale, where honest work matures like a sonnet rather than a spam blast.
